entry_state: The debt discussion continues through default notice, holder remedies and successor conditions; its earlier node span needs a supplemental correction. Loan origination, external settlement, commitment exposure and allowance measurement are distinct. Accounting equity requires instrument-specific prudential reconciliation. The bank path now constructs gross exposure, admitted allowance and excess allowance before calculating regulatory ratios; the reconciliation table continues next.
exit_state: Capital and allowance measures reconcile without supplying liquidity or payout permission. Asset classification requires contractual cash-flow and business-model findings before the loan method is chosen. ECL uses dated, probability-weighted discounted cash shortfalls; a twelve-month horizon selects default events rather than truncating later losses. The commitment example conditions on actual draw while preserving its original credit baseline and supported lifetime horizon; its remaining alternatives continue next.
findings: The allowance-cap calculation explains the incorrect circular denominator alternative and separates leverage average-assets evidence from closing assets.
Equal terminal cash under amortised cost, debt FVOCI and FVTPL does not establish equal interim measurement or presentation; equity FVOCI has distinct recycling treatment.
The commitment-to-loan transition carries the original credit-risk assessment, conditions probabilities on actual funding and removes the old provision. No new confirmed defect.

equation.exposition_role: Compute lifetime loss conditional on actual draw.
equation.symbols_units_domain: The two ratios are conditional probabilities and ten is money.
equation.assumptions_timing: Draw is observed; supported lifetime horizon and original credit baseline persist.
equation.source_and_equality: Each joint probability 0.1 is divided by draw probability 0.5, yielding total 0.4 times ten.
equation.interpretation: Neither retaining draw uncertainty nor resetting the horizon measures the funded exposure.
equation.transition: The resulting allowance replaces the old provision with an additional impairment charge.
